description:
Advances: specled.coverage_capture

Severity: Low. mix spec.check reports it itself: branch uncovered_policy_files=lib/specled_ex/coverage/paths.ex, test/specled_ex/coverage/paths_test.exs. The module was extracted this epic (specled_-dn4.12) to own coverage source-path identity, but no subject claims it, so a change to it trips no subject spec.

Why not on the release branch: binding it is a design choice, not bookkeeping — surface entry only, versus an api_boundary binding for module_source/2 that hash-pins the identity contract. Pinning it wrong is worse than not pinning it, and api_boundary hashes are position-sensitive.

Source: 2026-08-12 critical review SPEC-M4.
title: lib/specled_ex/coverage/paths.ex belongs to no subject surface
